effects: The signer pays exactly `assets` PYUSD to the vault (safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets) in enter).
The vault mints senPYUSDPRIMEv2 shares to `onBehalf`. The number of shares is previewDeposit(assets), set by the vault's share price after accrueInterest, with no minimum.
formats.shown: Deposit an exact PYUSD amount into the vault, with senPYUSDPRIMEv2 shares sent to the onBehalf address; the share amount is not shown.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is not shown; the vault computes it and there is no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The screen has only a 'Share ticker' constant field. Case 0: the signer received 1.001 senPYUSDPRIMEv2, an amount not on the screen.
findings.fix: Nothing in the calldata carries it. The 'Share ticker' field could instead read 'Receive: senPYUSDPRIMEv2 shares (amount set by vault price)'.

cases.notes: The 2 PYUSD out is shown exactly. The 1.001 senPYUSDPRIMEv2 in is named by ticker and recipient, but its amount is not shown and cannot be.

effects: The signer pays previewMint(shares) PYUSD, rounded up, to the vault. The vault's share price sets this amount and the code has no maximum.
The vault mints exactly `shares` senPYUSDPRIMEv2 to `onBehalf`.
formats.shown: Mint an exact number of senPYUSDPRIMEv2 shares for onBehalf; PYUSD is named as the deposit asset with no amount.

findings.title: mint: the PYUSD amount taken from the signer is not shown; the vault computes it with no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The 'Deposit asset' field shows only the constant 'PYUSD'. Case 1: 0.000001 PYUSD left the signer, an amount not on the screen.
findings.fix: The calldata does not carry this amount. Relabel the field to 'Pay with (amount set by vault price)' so it is clear an unbounded PYUSD amount will be pulled.

findings.title: mint: the intent sentence says 'Mint' and does not say PYUSD is taken from the signer.
findings.evidence: interpolatedIntent "Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}" renders 'Mint 0.000000001 senPYUSDPRIMEv2 for 0x...dEaD' (case 1). The PYUSD payment appears only in a separate raw field.
findings.fix: Use an interpolatedIntent like 'Deposit PYUSD to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}' and an intent like 'Deposit PYUSD for shares'.

cases.notes: The signer paid 1 unit (0.000001) of PYUSD. The asset is named but the amount is not. The shares went to 0xdead, so they are not a signer effect; the screen states this correctly.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns previewWithdraw(assets) senPYUSDPRIMEv2 shares (rounded up) from `onBehalf`, who may be the signer.
If the signer is not onBehalf, the signer spends onBehalf's share allowance by that number of shares.
The vault sends exactly `assets` PYUSD to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Withdraw an exact PYUSD amount to the receiver, with the owner address shown; the share burn is not mentioned.

findings.title: withdraw: nothing on the screen says the owner's senPYUSDPRIMEv2 shares are burned.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares);`. The fields are only 'Withdraw exactly', 'To' and 'Owner'. Case 2: the signer burned 359,695.2 senPYUSDPRIMEv2. The reader wrote 'Likely no tokens leave my wallet... shares may be burned, not shown'.
findings.fix: Relabel 'Owner' to 'Burn senPYUSDPRIMEv2 shares from', or add a constant field naming the shares that are burned.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned is computed by the vault and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets);`. This amount is not in the calldata. Case 2: 359,695,219,105,124,505,742,268 share wei were burned.

cases.notes: The 719,000 PYUSD in is shown exactly, with the right receiver. The reader guessed the share burn only vaguely, because the screen never names the shares.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` senPYUSDPRIMEv2 from `onBehalf`. If the signer is not onBehalf, it also spends the signer's share allowance.
The vault sends previewRedeem(shares) PYUSD to `receiver`. The vault's share price sets this amount and there is no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem an exact number of senPYUSDPRIMEv2 shares to the receiver; the asset paid out (PYUSD) and its amount are not stated.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names PYUSD as the asset the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);`. The redeem fields are only shares, 'To' and 'Owner', while mint shows `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`. Case 3: the signer received 100.000003 PYUSD. The reader wrote 'Some underlying asset (likely PYUSD...), amount not shown'.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and say 'for PYUSD' in the interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: redeem: the PYUSD amount paid out is computed by the vault, with no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);`. This amount is not in the calldata.

findings.title: redeem: 'Redeem {shares} to {receiver}' can read as if the shares are sent to the receiver.

cases.notes: The share burn is shown exactly. The PYUSD in is neither named nor quantified, and the reader only guessed the asset.
